ROOTED IN SOMETHING REAL

More than garri.
A little piece
of home.

It started with a simple request: “Please bring some garri when you come back.”

Friends and colleagues kept asking Taiwo Oludairo for garri from her hometown. Those requests grew into Ejire Onigarri — a business built around a familiar food and the people who love it.

Today, that feeling is at the heart of Ejire: Nigerian roots, everyday comfort, and something worth sharing.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT ASK

Good questions.
Simple answers.

Still curious? We’re a message away.

Ask Ejire ↗
How do I place an order?+

Add your selections to the enquiry bag, include your location and any preferences, then open the message in WhatsApp. Ejire will confirm what’s available, the price and delivery arrangements before you pay. You can also enquire by phone or email.

Which sizes and varieties are available?+

Ask Ejire for the current garri varieties and pack sizes. Add your preference in the enquiry notes so the team can recommend an option and share a current quote.

Can I order souvenir packs for an event?+

Yes, you can send a souvenir enquiry. Share your occasion, event date, expected number of packs and packaging ideas. Ejire will confirm the options and lead time with you.

What about delivery?+

Ejire is based in Ajah, Lagos. Include your delivery location when you enquire so delivery coverage, cost and timing can be confirmed for your order.

Can I order in larger quantities?+

Use “A bigger helping” to send a bulk enquiry. Include how much you need, your location and preferred date, and ask Ejire for availability and a quote.

How should I store my garri?+

Follow the storage instructions and best-before information on your pack. If you need advice for a particular product or packaging option, ask Ejire when ordering.
